title: Wheat field wind
prompt_en: 16:9 low angle. Golden wheat sways in waves under a big summer sky with slow-moving clouds. Camera slowly glides through the wheat tops. Warm late-afternoon sun, nostalgic mood.
prompt_zh: 16:9 低角度。金色麦浪在夏日大天空下摇曳，云朵缓慢移动。镜头缓缓滑过麦穗顶端。温暖的午后阳光，怀旧氛围。
why_it_works: Wind patterns across a field are visually clear and forgiving of small errors.
